<!--
Shared Cal.com embed used by the EN and DE services pages.

The embed script is only loaded after the visitor clicks the consent button
(GDPR: Cal.com Inc. is a US processor, see datenschutz.qmd). The including
page supplies the language-specific labels through data attributes on
`#cal-consent`.
-->

```{=html}
<div id="cal-booking"></div>
<script>
  (function () {
    const consent = document.getElementById("cal-consent");
    const target = document.getElementById("cal-booking");
    const calLink = "{{< var consultation.cal_link >}}";
    if (!consent || !target) return;
    const de = document.documentElement.lang === "de";
    let loaded = false;
    let product = "";

    function loadCal() {
      if (loaded) return;
      loaded = true;
      // Official Cal.com embed snippet (https://cal.com/docs/embed)
      (function (C, A, L) { let p = function (a, ar) { a.q.push(ar); }; let d = C.document; C.Cal = C.Cal || function () { let cal = C.Cal; let ar = arguments; if (!cal.loaded) { cal.ns = {}; cal.q = cal.q || []; d.head.appendChild(d.createElement("script")).src = A; cal.loaded = true; } if (ar[0] === L) { const api = function () { p(api, arguments); }; const namespace = ar[1]; api.q = api.q || []; if (typeof namespace === "string") { cal.ns[namespace] = cal.ns[namespace] || api; p(cal.ns[namespace], ar); p(cal, ["initNamespace", namespace]); } else p(cal, ar); return; } p(cal, ar); }; })(window, "https://app.cal.com/embed/embed.js", "init");
      const dark = document.documentElement.classList.contains("quarto-dark");
      const config = product ? { notes: (de ? "Interesse an: " : "Interested in: ") + product } : {};
      Cal("init", { origin: "https://cal.com" });
      Cal("inline", { elementOrSelector: "#cal-booking", calLink: calLink, layout: "month_view", config: config });
      Cal("ui", { theme: dark ? "dark" : "light", hideEventTypeDetails: false, layout: "month_view" });
      consent.hidden = true;
    }

    consent.addEventListener("click", loadCal);

    // Shop: "Buy now" / "Book now" jump to the calendar, remember the product
    // (shown above the calendar, prefilled in Cal.com notes and the e-mail subject)
    // and open the calendar. The shop notice informs about the Cal.com transfer.
    const selected = document.createElement("p");
    selected.id = "shop-selected";
    selected.hidden = true;
    consent.parentNode.insertBefore(selected, consent);

    document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
      const btn = e.target.closest && e.target.closest(".shop-buy");
      if (!btn) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      product = btn.dataset.product || "";
      selected.innerHTML = "";
      const label = document.createElement("strong");
      label.textContent = (de ? "Ausgewählt: " : "Selected: ");
      selected.append(label, product);
      selected.hidden = !product;
      const mail = document.querySelector('#contact a[href^="mailto:"]');
      if (mail && product) mail.setAttribute("href", mail.getAttribute("href").split("?")[0] + "?subject=" + encodeURIComponent(product));
      if (history.replaceState) history.replaceState(null, "", "#contact");
      document.getElementById("contact").scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
      loadCal();
    });
  })();
</script>
```
